# Pomodoso plugins — full reference

A plugin is one YAML file. Pomodoso validates it, stores it, and renders it with built-in components: the file can't run code, load scripts or call other services. Anything the format can't express doesn't exist yet — don't invent keys or block types.

## Rules that matter

- Keys (collections, fields, settings, computed, views) are lower_snake_case, up to 40 characters, starting with a letter. The plugin `id` is lower-kebab-case.
- Read a value anywhere a value goes with `$name`: a setting, a computed value or a built-in (`$today_date`, `$now`, `$tab.url`, `$tab.title`, `$tab.image`). `$tab.*` only works in an add-button's `prefill`.
- Put a value inside a label or text with `{$name}`.
- A one-tap action (counter-button, mini-counter, hook `yes`, day picks) has no form, so every required field of its collection must be optional, have a `default`, or be set by the action.
- Every record also has built-in fields you can list, sort and filter by without declaring them: `created_at` and `updated_at`, plus `occurred_at` on events and `day` on dailies.
- Literal values must fit their field: numbers within min/max, select values from `options`.
- The file is at most 256 KB.
- Validate against https://pomodoso.com/schema/plugin.v1.json; Pomodoso also checks that every collection, field and `$reference` you name exists, and says what's available when one doesn't.

## The file
- `schema_version` (required): 1. Always `1`.
- `id` (required): text. The plugin id, lower-kebab-case (`quit-smoking`). It never changes between versions.
- `name` (required): text. Shown in the app list.
- `version` (required): text. Semver, `1.0.0`. A breaking change needs a new major and a `migrate` block.
- `icon`: text. One word: book, film, grid, no-smoking, water, coffee, run, heart, mood, sleep, money, music, game, plant, pill, food, star, check, calendar, pen, link, code, brain, dumbbell. Anything else shows the initial.
- `description`: text. One sentence.
- `author`: text. Your name.
- `license`: text. Default MIT.
- `settings`: list of object. Values the user sets on install (a starting limit, a goal). Readable as `$key`.
- `collections` (required): list of object. What the plugin stores. Each has a `key`, a `kind` and `fields`. Empty (`[]`) for an app that keeps no data, like a year progress bar.
- `computed`: map of key → computed value. Named values calculated from the records, readable as `$name`.
- `views` (required): list of object. The screens of the plugin, each a list of blocks.
- `today`: object. Optional widget for the Today tab; the user switches it on. `default_on` suggests a starting state.
- `hooks`: list of object. Optional questions after pomodoros or at day end, and lines in reports.
- `rules`: list of object. Fields set automatically when a record starts matching `when` (stamp a date when a book becomes read). `only_if_empty` keeps a value the user set.
- `migrate`: object. How a breaking update carries existing records over: `from: "1.x"` and `steps` (rename_collection, rename_field, map_values, drop_field).

## Settings

Each setting:
  - `key` (required): key
  - `type` (required): number | text | boolean | select
  - `label` (required): text
  - `default`: text | number | true | false
  - `options`: list of key | object
  - `min`: number
  - `max`: number

## Collections

- `event`: Things that happen at a moment: a cigarette, a glass of water. Each record gets `occurred_at`.
- `item`: Things you keep and update: a book, a link. Records have no date of their own beyond `created_at`.
- `daily`: One record per day: a mood, a day state. Records have a `day`; saving the same day again updates it.

Each field:
  - `key` (required): key
  - `type` (required): text | longtext | number | scale | boolean | date | url | select | multiselect | tags | rating | duration | image_url
  - `label`: text
  - `optional`: true | false
  - `default`: text | number | true | false | list of text
  - `options`: list of key | object
  - `user_editable`: true | false
  - `min`: number
  - `max`: number
  - `unit`: text

Field types:

- `text`: One line of text.
- `longtext`: Multi-line text (notes).
- `number`: A number; `min`, `max` and `unit` are optional.
- `scale`: A number picked from a short range (default 1–5), shown as buttons.
- `boolean`: Yes / no, shown as a checkbox.
- `date`: A calendar day, YYYY-MM-DD.
- `url`: A link.
- `select`: One option from `options`. Add `user_editable: true` to let the user rename, recolor and add options.
- `multiselect`: Several options from `options`.
- `tags`: Free-form tags, typed comma-separated. No `options`.
- `rating`: Stars (default 1–5).
- `duration`: Minutes.
- `image_url`: An image link (https), shown as a cover in boards.

## Computed values

Each entry under `computed` has exactly one operator key, which names the collection (or holds the operator's settings). They can reference each other with `$name`, without cycles.

Ranges: `today`, `yesterday`, `this_week`, `last_week`, `this_month`, `last_month`, `this_year`, `all`, or a rolling window like `14d` or `12mo`.

### `count`

How many records match. Optional `where`, `range`, `by` (the date field the range applies to) and `group` (day | week | month, which makes it a series for charts).

  - `count` (required): key
  - `where`: map of key → text | number | true | false | object
  - `range`: today | yesterday | this_week | last_week | this_month | last_month | this_year | all | a rolling window like 14d or 12mo
  - `by`: key
  - `group`: day | week | month

### `sum`

Sum of a numeric `field` over the matching records. Same options as count.

  - `sum` (required): key
  - `field` (required): key
  - `where`: map of key → text | number | true | false | object
  - `range`: today | yesterday | this_week | last_week | this_month | last_month | this_year | all | a rolling window like 14d or 12mo
  - `by`: key
  - `group`: day | week | month

### `avg`

Average of a numeric `field`. Same options as count.

  - `avg` (required): key
  - `field` (required): key
  - `where`: map of key → text | number | true | false | object
  - `range`: today | yesterday | this_week | last_week | this_month | last_month | this_year | all | a rolling window like 14d or 12mo
  - `by`: key
  - `group`: day | week | month

### `min`

Smallest value of a numeric `field`. Same options as count.

  - `min` (required): key
  - `field` (required): key
  - `where`: map of key → text | number | true | false | object
  - `range`: today | yesterday | this_week | last_week | this_month | last_month | this_year | all | a rolling window like 14d or 12mo
  - `by`: key
  - `group`: day | week | month

### `max`

Largest value of a numeric `field`. Same options as count.

  - `max` (required): key
  - `field` (required): key
  - `where`: map of key → text | number | true | false | object
  - `range`: today | yesterday | this_week | last_week | this_month | last_month | this_year | all | a rolling window like 14d or 12mo
  - `by`: key
  - `group`: day | week | month

### `last`

The most recent record (or its `field`). Optional `where`.

  - `last` (required): key
  - `where`: map of key → text | number | true | false | object
  - `field`: key

### `first`

The oldest record (or its `field`). Optional `where`.

  - `first` (required): key
  - `where`: map of key → text | number | true | false | object
  - `field`: key

### `streak`

Consecutive days, ending today, with a count within `at_least` / `at_most`. Optional `where`.

  - `streak` (required): key
  - `where`: map of key → text | number | true | false | object
  - `at_least`: value (number, $reference or computed)
  - `at_most`: value (number, $reference or computed)

### `taper`

A value that changes by a step every period since install: `from`, `down_by` or `up_by`, `every` (day | week | month), optional `min` / `max`. For limits that tighten over time.

  - `taper` (required): object
    - `from` (required): value (number, $reference or computed)
    - `down_by`: value (number, $reference or computed)
    - `up_by`: value (number, $reference or computed)
    - `every` (required): day | week | month
    - `min`: value (number, $reference or computed)
    - `max`: value (number, $reference or computed)

### `delta`

Relative change between two values, `[a, b]` → (a − b) / b. Reads as a percent in templates.

  - `delta` (required): [value (number, $reference or computed), value (number, $reference or computed)]

### `calendar`

How far the current `week`, `month` or `year` has gone, from the date alone (no collection). `show`: `progress` (default, a fraction: 0.43 on day 158 of 365), `passed` (days so far, today included), `left` (days after today) or `total` (days in the period).

  - `calendar` (required): week | month | year
  - `show`: progress | passed | left | total

## Views and blocks

Each view has an `id`, an optional `label` (the tab name) and `blocks`, shown top to bottom.

### `counter-button`

A big button that adds a record to an event collection in one tap. `set` fills fields; `details: form` opens a form instead. `subtract: true` adds a − button that deletes the latest one from today (a tap by mistake).

  - `label` (required): text
  - `adds` (required): key
  - `details`: none | form
  - `set`: map of key → text | number | true | false
  - `subtract`: true | false

### `add-button`

A button that opens a form to add an item. `prefill` can use `$tab.url`, `$tab.title` and `$tab.image` (the current page and its preview image), so one tap saves the page you are on.

  - `label` (required): text
  - `adds` (required): key
  - `prefill`: map of key → text | number | true | false

### `form`

An inline form for a collection. On a daily collection it edits today. On an event collection it also asks "When" (now by default), to log one you forgot.

  - `collection` (required): key

### `stat`

One number or value with a label. `format` says how it reads.

  - `label` (required): text
  - `value` (required): value (number, $reference or computed)
  - `format`: number | time_ago | days | percent | share | duration | date

### `stat-row`

Up to four stats side by side.

  - `items` (required): list of object

### `progress`

A bar of `value` against `max`. `invert: true` for limits (going over is bad). `format` says how the numbers read (`share` shows only the percent). `style`: `bar` (default), `ring` (a ring of dots) or `dots` (one dot per unit when `max` is a whole number up to 400, like the days of a year); it can be a `$setting` so the user picks.

  - `label`: text
  - `value` (required): value (number, $reference or computed)
  - `max` (required): value (number, $reference or computed)
  - `invert`: true | false
  - `format`: number | time_ago | days | percent | share | duration | date
  - `style`: bar | ring | dots | $reference

### `chart`

A bar or line chart of a grouped series (`count` / `sum` / … with `group`). Optional dashed `reference` line.

  - `label`: text
  - `kind` (required): bar | line
  - `series` (required): computed value
  - `reference`: value (number, $reference or computed)

### `list`

Records as rows: `primary` field, up to three `secondary` ones, optional `filter`, `sort`, `open` (a url field) and a `swipe` action that sets fields.

  - `collection` (required): key
  - `filter`: map of key → text | number | true | false | object
  - `primary` (required): key
  - `secondary`: list of key
  - `open`: key
  - `sort`: object
    - `field` (required): key
    - `order`: asc | desc
  - `swipe`: object
    - `label`: text
    - `set` (required): map of key → text | number | true | false

### `tag-filter`

Chips that filter the lists and boards of the same view by a tags, multiselect or select field.

  - `collection` (required): key
  - `field` (required): key

### `board`

Items grouped in columns by a select field (`group_by`), as cards with title, subtitle, image and badge.

  - `collection` (required): key
  - `group_by` (required): key
  - `card` (required): object
    - `title` (required): key
    - `subtitle`: key
    - `image`: key
    - `badge`: key

### `year-grid`

Every day of the year as a colored cell (like a contribution graph), colored by a select field.

  - `collection` (required): key
  - `color_by`: key
  - `legend`: true | false

### `day-picker`

Pick a select value for today, or move to other days.

  - `collection` (required): key
  - `field` (required): key

### `breakdown`

How many records have each option of a select, multiselect or tags field, as bars.

  - `collection` (required): key
  - `field` (required): key
  - `range`: today | yesterday | this_week | last_week | this_month | last_month | this_year | all | a rolling window like 14d or 12mo

### `text`

A paragraph; `{$name}` inside it is replaced by the value.

  - `text` (required): text

## Today widget

`today: { default_on: true | false, widget: … }`

### `mini-counter`

A number with a + button that adds to an event collection (`adds`). Optional `max`; `subtract: true` adds a − button that deletes the latest one from today.

  - `label` (required): text
  - `value` (required): value (number, $reference or computed)
  - `max`: value (number, $reference or computed)
  - `adds` (required): key
  - `subtract`: true | false

### `select-today`

Option chips that set today's value of a daily collection's select field. `after: year-grid` shows the year in pixels (colored by that field) once today is set, with a Change link to pick again.

  - `label` (required): text
  - `collection` (required): key
  - `field` (required): key
  - `after`: year-grid

### `count-badge`

A single number.

  - `label` (required): text
  - `value` (required): value (number, $reference or computed)

### `stat`

A single value with a `format`.

  - `label` (required): text
  - `value` (required): value (number, $reference or computed)
  - `format`: number | time_ago | days | percent | share | duration | date

### `progress`

A bar of `value` against `max` (default 1), with an optional `format`, a `caption` line under it (`{$name}` works) and a `style` (`bar`, `ring` or `dots`, or a `$setting`). Ring and dots take the whole row.

  - `label` (required): text
  - `value` (required): value (number, $reference or computed)
  - `max`: value (number, $reference or computed)
  - `format`: number | time_ago | days | percent | share | duration | date
  - `caption`: text
  - `style`: bar | ring | dots | $reference

### `stats`

Up to four values side by side, each with its `label` and optional `format` (`items`). More than two take the whole row on Today.

  - `label` (required): text
  - `items` (required): list of object

## Hooks

- `pomodoro_end`: After a pomodoro, during the break: `ask` a question; `yes` adds a record to an event collection, or `pick` sets a select on today. At most one plugin question per break.
- `day_end`: The next day: `ask` about yesterday, with `yes` (adds a record to an event collection, dated yesterday) or `pick` (sets a select on yesterday's daily record).
- `daily_report`: A `line` added to the daily report, with `{$name}` values.
- `weekly_report`: A `line` added to the weekly report.

A pomodoro_end / day_end hook:
  - `on` (required): pomodoro_end | day_end
  - `ask` (required): text
  - `yes`: object
    - `add` (required): key
    - `set`: map of key → text | number | true | false
  - `pick`: object
    - `collection` (required): key
    - `field` (required): key

A daily_report / weekly_report hook:
  - `on` (required): daily_report | weekly_report
  - `line` (required): text

A prompt hook takes exactly one of `yes` or `pick`.

## Stat formats

- `number`: 12, 2.5
- `time_ago`: 3h 20m ago (for timestamps such as `last`)
- `days`: 8 days
- `percent`: +20%, −34% (for fractions such as `delta`)
- `share`: 43.3%: a fraction as a plain percent (`calendar` progress). In a progress block or widget, the value as a share of `max` (158 of 365 reads 43.3%).
- `duration`: 1h 35m (minutes)
- `date`: Oct 21, 2026

## Common mistakes

- Inventing a block type (`kanban`, `calendar`): use `board` or `year-grid`. The error lists what's available.
- A counter-button on a collection with a required field and no `set` or `default` for it.
- Writing a reference without `$` (`value: today` instead of `value: $today`).
- A chart series without `group`: charts need `count` / `sum` / `avg` / `min` / `max` with `group: day | week | month`.
- `options` on a field that isn't select or multiselect (tags take no options).
- Naming a setting or computed value `now` or `today_date` (built in).
- A breaking change (renaming or removing a field, collection or option, changing a type) without a new major version and a `migrate` block.

## Complete examples

### quit-smoking

```yaml
schema_version: 1
id: quit-smoking
name: Quit smoking
version: 1.1.0
icon: no-smoking
description: A daily limit that drops every week. Log each one and watch the trend go down.
author: Pomodoso
license: MIT

settings:
  - { key: start_limit, type: number, label: Starting daily limit, default: 15, min: 0 }
  - { key: weekly_reduction, type: number, label: Reduce every week by, default: 1, min: 0 }

collections:
  - key: cigarette
    kind: event
    fields:
      - { key: craving, type: scale, label: "How strong was the craving?", min: 1, max: 5, optional: true }
      - key: trigger
        type: select
        optional: true
        options: [coffee, stress, after_meal, pomodoro_break, social]
      - { key: note, type: text, optional: true }

computed:
  today: { count: cigarette, range: today }
  limit: { taper: { from: $start_limit, down_by: $weekly_reduction, every: week, min: 0 } }
  last: { last: cigarette }
  under_limit: { streak: cigarette, at_most: $limit }
  week: { count: cigarette, range: this_week }
  last_week: { count: cigarette, range: last_week }
  week_change: { delta: [$week, $last_week] }

views:
  - id: main
    blocks:
      - { type: counter-button, label: Smoked one, adds: cigarette, subtract: true }
      - { type: progress, value: $today, max: $limit, invert: true }
      - type: stat-row
        items:
          - { label: Since last, value: $last, format: time_ago }
          - { label: Under limit, value: $under_limit, format: days }
          - { label: vs last week, value: $week_change, format: percent }
      - type: chart
        label: Last 14 days
        kind: bar
        series: { count: cigarette, group: day, range: 14d }
        reference: $limit
  - id: log
    label: Log with details
    blocks:
      - type: text
        text: Forgot one? Set "When" to the time you smoked it.
      - { type: form, collection: cigarette }

today:
  default_on: true
  widget: { type: mini-counter, label: Cigarettes, value: $today, max: $limit, adds: cigarette, subtract: true }

hooks:
  - on: pomodoro_end
    ask: Did you smoke during this break?
    yes: { add: cigarette, set: { trigger: pomodoro_break } }
  - on: weekly_report
    line: "Cigarettes: {$week} this week ({$week_change} vs last week)"
```

### year-in-pixels

```yaml
schema_version: 1
id: year-in-pixels
name: "Year in Pixels: Happiness"
version: 2.1.0
icon: mood
description: Color every day by how happy it was. You choose the states and their colors.
author: Pomodoso
license: MIT

collections:
  - key: day_state
    kind: daily
    fields:
      - key: state
        type: select
        user_editable: true
        options:
          - { value: great, label: Great, color: "#2D8A7A" }
          - { value: good, label: Good, color: "#8FB08F" }
          - { value: okay, label: Okay, color: "#E8D9A8" }
          - { value: bad, label: Bad, color: "#D98C7A" }
          - { value: awful, label: Awful, color: "#A8432D" }
      - { key: note, type: text, optional: true }

computed:
  logged_this_year: { count: day_state, range: this_year }
  good_streak: { streak: day_state, where: { state: { in: [great, good] } }, at_least: 1 }

views:
  - id: main
    blocks:
      - { type: day-picker, collection: day_state, field: state }
      - { type: year-grid, collection: day_state, color_by: state, legend: true }
      - { type: breakdown, collection: day_state, field: state, range: this_year }
      - type: stat-row
        items:
          - { label: Days logged this year, value: $logged_this_year }
          - { label: Good days in a row, value: $good_streak, format: days }

today:
  default_on: true
  widget: { type: select-today, label: How happy was today?, collection: day_state, field: state, after: year-grid }

hooks:
  - on: day_end
    ask: How happy was yesterday?
    pick: { collection: day_state, field: state }

# 1.x mixed mood and productivity; productivity now has its own app
# (productivity-pixels). Its states map to the closest mood.
migrate:
  from: "1.x"
  steps:
    - map_values: { collection: day_state, field: state, map: { productive: good, normal: okay, unproductive: bad } }
```

### reading-list

```yaml
schema_version: 1
id: reading-list
name: Reading list
version: 1.1.0
icon: bookmark
description: Articles, videos and papers to get to later, organized with tags.
author: Pomodoso
license: MIT

collections:
  - key: link
    kind: item
    title_field: title
    fields:
      - { key: url, type: url }
      - { key: title, type: text }
      - { key: kind, type: select, options: [article, video, paper, other], default: article }
      - { key: tags, type: tags, optional: true }
      - { key: status, type: select, options: [to_read, done], default: to_read }
      - { key: done_on, type: date, label: Read on, optional: true }

computed:
  to_read: { count: link, where: { status: to_read } }
  read_week: { count: link, where: { status: done }, range: this_week, by: done_on }
  read_month: { count: link, where: { status: done }, range: this_month, by: done_on }
  read_year: { count: link, where: { status: done }, range: this_year, by: done_on }

views:
  - id: main
    blocks:
      - type: add-button
        label: Save current tab
        adds: link
        prefill: { url: $tab.url, title: $tab.title }
      - { type: tag-filter, collection: link, field: tags }
      - type: list
        collection: link
        filter: { status: to_read }
        primary: title
        secondary: [kind, tags]
        open: url
        sort: { field: created_at, order: desc }
        swipe: { label: Done, set: { status: done } }
  - id: done
    label: Done
    blocks:
      - type: stat-row
        items:
          - { label: Read this week, value: $read_week }
          - { label: This month, value: $read_month }
          - { label: This year, value: $read_year }
      - type: list
        collection: link
        filter: { status: done }
        primary: title
        secondary: [done_on]
        open: url
        sort: { field: done_on, order: desc }

today:
  default_on: true
  widget:
    type: stats
    label: Reading list
    items:
      - { label: To read, value: $to_read }
      - { label: Read this week, value: $read_week }
      - { label: Month, value: $read_month }
      - { label: Year, value: $read_year }

rules:
  - collection: link
    when: { status: done }
    set: { done_on: $today_date }
    only_if_empty: true
```

### bookshelf

```yaml
schema_version: 1
id: bookshelf
name: Bookshelf
version: 1.1.0
icon: book
description: Books you want to read, are reading and have read.
author: Pomodoso
license: MIT

collections:
  - key: book
    kind: item
    title_field: title
    fields:
      - { key: title, type: text }
      - { key: author, type: text, optional: true }
      - { key: status, type: select, options: [want, reading, read], default: want }
      - { key: rating, type: rating, optional: true }
      - { key: tags, type: tags, optional: true }
      - { key: cover, type: image_url, optional: true }
      - { key: link, type: url, optional: true }
      - { key: finished_on, type: date, optional: true }

computed:
  reading: { count: book, where: { status: reading } }
  read_this_year: { count: book, where: { status: read }, range: this_year, by: finished_on }

views:
  - id: main
    blocks:
      - type: add-button
        label: Add the book on this page
        adds: book
        prefill: { title: $tab.title, link: $tab.url, cover: $tab.image }
      - { type: add-button, label: Add a book, adds: book }
      - { type: tag-filter, collection: book, field: tags }
      - type: board
        collection: book
        group_by: status
        card: { title: title, subtitle: author, image: cover, badge: rating }
  - id: stats
    label: Stats
    blocks:
      - { type: stat, label: Read this year, value: $read_this_year }
      - type: chart
        label: Books per month
        kind: bar
        series: { count: book, where: { status: read }, by: finished_on, group: month, range: 12mo }

today:
  default_on: true
  widget:
    type: stats
    label: Bookshelf
    items:
      - { label: Reading, value: $reading }
      - { label: Read this year, value: $read_this_year }

rules:
  - collection: book
    when: { status: read }
    set: { finished_on: $today_date }
    only_if_empty: true
```

### movieshelf

```yaml
schema_version: 1
id: movieshelf
name: Movieshelf
version: 1.1.0
icon: film
description: Movies to watch and the ones you've seen.
author: Pomodoso
license: MIT

collections:
  - key: movie
    kind: item
    title_field: title
    fields:
      - { key: title, type: text }
      - { key: director, type: text, optional: true }
      - { key: status, type: select, options: [watchlist, watched], default: watchlist }
      - { key: rating, type: rating, optional: true }
      - { key: tags, type: tags, optional: true }
      - { key: cover, type: image_url, optional: true }
      - { key: link, type: url, optional: true }
      - { key: watched_on, type: date, optional: true }

computed:
  watchlist: { count: movie, where: { status: watchlist } }
  watched_this_year: { count: movie, where: { status: watched }, range: this_year, by: watched_on }

views:
  - id: main
    blocks:
      - type: add-button
        label: Add the movie on this page
        adds: movie
        prefill: { title: $tab.title, link: $tab.url, cover: $tab.image }
      - { type: add-button, label: Add a movie, adds: movie }
      - { type: tag-filter, collection: movie, field: tags }
      - type: board
        collection: movie
        group_by: status
        card: { title: title, subtitle: director, image: cover, badge: rating }
  - id: stats
    label: Stats
    blocks:
      - { type: stat, label: Watched this year, value: $watched_this_year }
      - type: chart
        label: Movies per month
        kind: bar
        series: { count: movie, where: { status: watched }, by: watched_on, group: month, range: 12mo }

today:
  default_on: true
  widget:
    type: stats
    label: Movieshelf
    items:
      - { label: Watchlist, value: $watchlist }
      - { label: Watched this year, value: $watched_this_year }

rules:
  - collection: movie
    when: { status: watched }
    set: { watched_on: $today_date }
    only_if_empty: true
```
